name: Torna

attributes.attribute: a High King of the nine hostages

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Torna is a hero of the sons of Ireland. He is a smaller voice in the tale of the High King Niall. He is a poet of true worth at the court. His verse told the future of the child king. He gave his aid to Niall's mother in the hours of her need. He stands in the story of the Nine Hostages.

okr.objective: Record the poet of the court.
key_results: He is a poet for the king
His verse told the child's future
